newsitem.title: USA: Arvin sees $8.0 mln charge for projects.
newsitem.headline: Arvin sees $8.0 mln charge for projects.

text.p: Arvin Industries Inc said Friday it expects a one-time charge of about $8.0 million related to profit improvement projects that are part of its continuing cost-reduction program.

Arvin said it has identified several projects in its planning process for 1997 that can be initiated in the fourth quarter of 1996. These projects will contribute to better 1997 earnings and cash flow, it said.

The automotive component manufacturer said the profit improvement program would more than offset the loss of equity interest in Fric-Rot S.A.I.C., which the company said Friday it sold to Tenneco Inc for about $17 million
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Arvin shares were down 1/4 to 23-5/8 Friday.
